topic: Formation of Quadratic Equations from Roots
title: Build the Equation Backwards Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Usually we get an equation and find its roots. Ravi turned it around for Aarav: the roots are 2 and 5, what is the equation? Then harder: the roots are 1 + 2i and 1 - 2i, so build an equation with no i anywhere in it. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 4, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations) we build quadratic equations backwards, from their roots.

You will move two roots on the Argand plane and watch the equation x² - 6x + c rebuild itself live: the sum stays 6 while the product counts up from 5 to 13 and the curve lifts off the axis. We derive x² - (sum)x + (product) = 0 in four small steps, see why any multiple k of the equation has the same roots, and build a real equation from a complex conjugate pair. Two pause-and-think questions, the exam trap with the middle sign, an original JEE Main pattern question on the roots α² and β², a recap card and three questions to check yourself. This episode completes Chapter 4.

Note: forming quadratic equations from given roots is in the JEE Main syllabus but not in the current rationalised NCERT text.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.
